notes.title: Updated release window.
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32599720/4d032cac0056860175894b43d5c697b38b091c0c.jpg

Hello everyone!
The release of Synther has been delayed until 2019. The additional time spent in development will allow the team to create a lot of cool new features, polish the product, and deliver to our audience the best possible version of Synther.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32599720/55216ed8dad95d82f4ee55c8c667d311e389a596.jpg

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32599720/9e3e3dfdcd49c400f534693bf113a2da74993481.jpg

We have submitted Synther in a playable state to the IGF 2019 contest. Finalists are expected to be posted in January of 2019 and the results will be presented in March at GDC in San Francisco.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32599720/ad8c80828c9d4c803cf1580441cfa81c5c981c6a.jpg

Lastly be sure to join our growing community on our Discord channel and be sure to stay up to date with everything Synther via our social media!

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/synthergame/
